page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.13xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz, the instance delivers 52 vCPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM. This configuration provides approximately 7.38 GB of memory per core, positioning the server primarily for memory-bound workloads.

The server features a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses or integrated local storage. Applications requiring persistent storage must utilize network-attached cloud block storage. The hardware profile omits discrete GPUs, focusing system resource allocation entirely on memory capacity and multi-core processor density.

With its high memory-to-vCPU ratio across 52 dedicated processing cores, the ecs.r6.13xlarge offers effective resource scaling for in-memory databases, enterprise caching systems, and heavy data processing pipelines that demand substantial memory buffers.
